name: Queries Database
description: A component connects to a PostgreSQL database. The target is open: an RDS instance (aws_core__aws_rds_instance) here, any full PostgreSQL elsewhere. Aurora is not supported by GitLab.

database.description: Which logical database (GitLab decomposes main and ci; the registry and Praefect have their own).

role.description: Whether this connection is to the primary or a read replica.

tls_mode.description: The libpq sslmode the component uses.
